plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted (a) a check of each case's category against the requester's rule (C3); the library has no instrument that reads categories, so a wrong category would be missed. (b) A check that each sending call left a row in the outbox (C10). 'trace of a call' is priced at 10 per named line, so 100 lines cost 1000 against an allowance of 50, and 'sent as released' only reads the record. (c) A check that each read returned only approved customers (C5). 'scope of a call' is also per named line, so 101 reads cost about 1010 against the same allowance. Only a few lines can be paid for from the allowance, so these clauses are left unshown. (d) A direct check of the live tables after promotion. The library's checks read the staged set, and the live tables are tied to it only through the promotion's line in the record.
